title: M3-3 DvP plan completion: Phase C (D/ST Sit/Start), T26/T27, verify mode, idempotent reruns, missing deliverables
objective: Close every remaining action item of the owner's DvP specification v1.1 that can run now: Phase C (C00-C05) for D/ST, the only group with a credible group-level signal, with a predeclared rule and a prospective freeze before 2026 week 12; tests T26 and T27; a verify-only mode that reads artifacts back and reproduces receipts; idempotent reruns that never rewrite frozen files or evidence; METRICS.csv, calibration and error-by-season plots, the per-position conclusion table and a deliverables map; and accurate project records. No production, weight or canonical-table change.

review.summary: Audited every action item of the owner's DvP specification v1.1 (sections 4-12) against the repository: test IDs T01-T40 by test function, experiment registry statuses, section 11 deliverables, CLI contracts, the frozen manifest. Found open: Phase 5 (C00-C05) PLANNED though D/ST was PROMISING (the section 5 gate is a credible group-level signal, not prospective confirmation); T26 and T27 had no tests; no verify-only mode; METRICS.csv, calibration and error-by-season plots and the section 11 per-position conclusions table missing; the project next action was stale (weather PR from 2026-11-22). Reproduction rerun on scratch copies: the 2025 holdout from the frozen commit 165d140 and development/validation from main give identical forecast content and results; found R-075 (a development rerun rewrote frozen-candidates metadata; forecast bytes are row-order dependent). Arbit has no player projection (the app says projections are not built) and FFA lineups exist only for 2026 periods 1-10 (read-only query).

plan.summary: 1) Declare Phase C first (config/dvp/sitstart.json): D/ST only by the gate; C00 = B00; pairwise start/sit accuracy of the frozen b06 vs b00 on every same-week pair; ties; close and waiver-pool subgroups; week-block bootstrap 2,000/1729; practical minimum 1.8 points derived from Phase B's 1% RMSE minimum and B00's development Spearman; rule PROMISING/INCONCLUSIVE/NOT_USEFUL/BLOCKED; commit and push before computing. 2) decisions.py (pure) and dvp.py sitstart on hash-checked frozen forecasts. 3) dvp.py verify (verify-only, T27). 4) Idempotent reruns (R-075). 5) T26/T27 tests and the T31 scan list. 6) Freeze Phase C for 2026 weeks 12-18 before 2026-11-26 01:00 UTC. 7) report: METRICS.csv, calibration, error-by-season, sitstart plots; registry. 8) Documents and records.

implementation.summary: decisions.py: units (D/ST forecast row -> the scoring D/ST, orientation checked against canonical observations, fails closed), pairs, metrics (accuracy, changed choices, points from changes, worst cases, within-week Spearman, top 8, subgroups, week-block bootstrap), decide. dvp.py: sitstart (checks frozen candidates and audit run, forecast hashes, projection-like columns, common rows); verify (v0 bytes, frozen commit vs manifest via git show, working-tree changes, audit outputs, every metric recomputed, label joins, D/ST whole points, relative bias, sign, sample, receipts verified); write_forecasts and content_sha256 (write once, refuse different content); development never rewrites frozen-candidates.json; report adds METRICS.csv and three plots; registry adds C00-C05 records; SCANNED adds decisions.py. config/dvp/frozen-phase-c.json frozen 2026-11-24T06:57:55Z. Results: Phase C PROMISING (+4.45/+8.55/+6.62 points); verify PASSED (468 metrics).

validation.summary: Checks at f3ceabf+receipt: foundation, model tests (157 with ARBIT_DVP_AUDIT_RUN; 155 + 2 skipped without, as CI), point-in-time, ruff check and format, mypy, full Python suite: all exit 0. dvp.py verify PASSED: 468 of 468 committed metrics recompute exactly; labels join 1:1 and equal observations; D/ST labels whole; relative bias under 15%; D/ST term sign positive (0.24, 0.35, 0.28); frozen commit matches all 11 frozen hashes; v0 byte-identical. Reproduction on scratch copies: 2025 holdout from 165d140, development and 2024 from main: keys, labels and missing cells identical; 18 (holdout) and 881 (development) float values differ by at most 7e-15 (parallel sums); results, selection, sensitivity and folds identical. R-075 fix shown on the real development stage: forecasts file and frozen-candidates hashes unchanged after a rerun. Phase C rerun from bac02af: receipt identical apart from code and time. Phase C rule committed (317361f, pushed 06:48 UTC) before results (bac02af).

journal.note: My previous report treated Phase C as waiting on the prospective 2026 confirmation; the specification's gate (section 5) is a credible group-level signal, which D/ST had. Phase C has now run. I also first wrote that rerun forecasts were identical; measured, up to 881 values differ by at most 7e-15 (parallel sums). Documents state the measured difference.

Phase C D/ST: pairwise start/sit accuracy B06 vs B00 +4.45 (dev), +8.55 (2024), +6.62 (2025) points, minimum 1.8 declared first: PROMISING. Points per changed choice +1.6 to +2.7; worst single choice -40.
Owner decision after the prospective 2026 window (both levels): whether the D/ST opponent term (B06) may enter the Sit/Start model as a weighted contribution (OWN-074).

The prospective 2026 scoring must run the frozen method from the freeze commit's tree (165d140); dvp.py on main differs from the frozen hash by design. The prospective harness must be a new file that calls the frozen library unchanged.
